capabilities.description: Cursor Next Line Ps times and reset to column 1.
Cursor Previous Line Ps times and reset to column 1.
Cursor Horizontal Absolute to column Ps.
Query the effective terminal background preference: dark (1) or light (2).
Opt in to dark/light background-preference transitions; subscription is queryable with DECRQM.
Wheel sends cursor-up/down keys on the alternate screen while mouse reporting is off; DECSET/DECRST override the host default and DECRQM reports the effective value.

Left/right margin mode. Off by default; DECRQM reports 1/2. While set, CSI Pl;Pr s is DECSLRM instead of SCOSC; resetting it, RIS, DECSTR, DECALN and a resize restore full-width margins (RIS also resets the mode). State transfer carries the mode and the margins. DECRQSS for the margins is not implemented.

Set left/right margins while DECLRMM is set (otherwise CSI s stays SCOSC): omitted/zero Pl is 1, omitted/zero/oversized Pr the last column, Pl not left of Pr is ignored; applied margins home the cursor (to the top-left margin corner under DECOM). The margins bound printing and autowrap (a wrap returns to the left margin and is not a soft wrap), CR/NEL/CNL/CPL, CUF/CUB/BS, HT, CUP/HVP/CHA/HPA and CPR under DECOM, IND/RI/LF at the region edges (a cursor outside them neither scrolls nor moves there), SU/SD, IL/DL, ICH/DCH, insert mode, DECIC/DECDC/SL/SR and DECOM rectangle columns. Partial-width scrolls never feed scrollback, move side tables with their cells, retire wide glyphs cut by a margin and remove images overlapping the band. ED/EL/ECH, DECBI/DECFI and DECRQSS are not bounded or implemented.
Save session runtime colors, including the 256-color palette; bounded to the newest 16 frames.
Restore session runtime colors, including the 256-color palette; bounded to the newest 16 frames.
Presenting hosts with desktop clipboard services opt in to MIME paste events. Headless and mux hosts report unrecognized.
Enable overline independently of underline; SGR 0 resets both.
Disable overline without changing underline style or color.
Report the current VT text-area size in characters as CSI 8 ; rows ; cols t.
Save the raw window title and/or icon name (Ps 0/1/2) on a 10-entry stack; the oldest entry is discarded on overflow.
Restore the saved raw window title and/or icon name (Ps 0/1/2) and raise the title callback; an empty pop is a no-op.
Report an unassigned, nonunique all-zero terminal unit identifier for default/zero tertiary DA.
Set xterm modifyOtherKeys level 0, 1 or 2 for the active screen (CSI > 4 ; Pv m); CSI > 4 m, an empty Pv, CSI > m and CSI > 4 n reset it to 0. Level 3 and other resources are ignored.
Report the active screen's modifyOtherKeys level as CSI > 4 ; Pv m. Queries for untracked key-modifier resources stay silent.

Report current absolute one-based VT margins with xterm status 1, only for exact complete r requests terminated by standard ST. BEL recovery and incomplete DCS stay negative; other settings are unavailable apart from the separately listed m and SP q reports.

Report the active pen as an SGR a client can replay, xterm style: status 1, a leading 0, attributes, 4:n underline styles, short ANSI or 38/48/58 semicolon color forms. Only exact complete m requests terminated by standard ST succeed.
Report the DECSCUSR value: 0 while the host's configured cursor is shown, otherwise xterm's 1-6 shape-and-blink code. Only exact complete SP q requests terminated by standard ST succeed.

Report terminfo capabilities from Ntilde's shared capability table, one reply per hex-encoded name: DCS 1+r name=value ST for strings and numbers, DCS 1+r name ST for flags, DCS 0+r ST for names not in the table. An invalid, truncated, BEL-terminated or oversized list gets a single DCS 0+r ST. Ms is answered only while the host accepts OSC 52 writes, never from a persistent session's daemon.

Report Sixel graphics attributes as xterm does, CSI ? Pi ; Ps ; Pv S. Pi 1: 4096 color registers for read, reset and read-maximum; set succeeds only for 4096. Pi 2: read gives the text area in Sixel pixels (columns and rows times the cell size Sixel placement uses, device pixels on a scaled display) capped at 2000 per side, read-maximum gives 2000;2000, reset and set fail (Ps 3). ReGIS and other items get Ps 1, unknown actions Ps 2. Only the exact three-parameter form is answered.
Modes 0, 1 and 2 erase their ED region except DECSCA-protected characters, and are ordinary ED while nothing is protected. Undefined mode 3 is ignored; it never clears scrollback.
Modes 0, 1 and 2 alias ordinary line erase; DECSEL does not yet spare DECSCA-protected characters. Undefined mode 3 is ignored; it never clears scrollback.

Erase a bounded stored-text rectangle with omitted/zero borders, page clipping and DECOM row origin; preserve cursor, pen and row wrapping. Wide/scaled text follows existing atomic erasure. Image-plane erasure remains unqualified; protected characters are erased too.

Fill a bounded stored-text rectangle with one character (32-126 through the in-use GL set, 160-255 as Latin-1) carrying the live SGR pen; omitted/zero borders, page clipping and DECOM row origin; preserve cursor, pen and row wrapping. Invalid character codes and reversed borders are ignored. Filled characters are written under the live DECSCA pen. Image-plane and Unicode/wide-fill behavior remain unqualified.

Copy a bounded stored-text rectangle on page 1 as if the source were read first (overlap-safe), keeping character, attributes, colors, hyperlinks and underline decoration, with omitted/zero borders, page clipping and DECOM row origin; preserve cursor, pen and row wrapping. A source or destination page other than 0/1 is ignored. DECSCA protection travels with the copied characters. Image-plane, scaled-text and multi-page behavior remain unqualified.

Set or clear bold, underline, blink and inverse (selectors 0, 1, 4, 5, 7, 22, 24, 25, 27; other selectors are ignored) over a stored-cell stream or rectangle with omitted/zero borders, page clipping and DECOM row origin; text, colors, side tables, cursor and the SGR pen are untouched. Margins do not clip. In the stream extent cells past a row's written extent are left alone while the rectangle changes them; protection is untouched (attributes only) and OSC 66 block atomicity is not modelled.

Reverse (toggle) bold, underline, blink and inverse (selectors 0, 1, 4, 5, 7; 22/24/25/27 and other selectors are ignored) over the DECSACE stream or rectangle with the DECCARA borders and clipping; selector 0 or an omitted list reverses all four. Text, colors, side tables, cursor and the SGR pen are untouched. Protection is untouched (attributes only).

Select the DECCARA/DECRARA extent: 0 or 1 (default) is the stream from the first to the second position, 2 the rectangle. Other values are ignored. RIS restores the stream; DECSTR keeps the selection; state transfer carries it. DECRQSS for the setting is not implemented.

Off by default: answered only when the host turns on the AllowRectangleChecksumReport setting (a one-cell checksum names that cell's character, so the report can read the screen back); otherwise silent. When on, CSI Pi;Pg;Pt;Pl;Pb;Pr * y replies DCS Pi ! ~ XXXX ST: four uppercase hex digits of the negated 16-bit sum of each cell's Unicode scalar plus bold 0x80, blink 0x40, reverse 0x20 and underline 0x10. Blanks count as spaces, a wide glyph once at its lead cell, combining marks and other attributes add nothing. Omitted Pi is 0; Pg is not interpreted; the rectangle uses the DECERA defaults, DECOM row offset and page clipping, and an inverted rectangle sums nothing. Only the exact unprefixed identity with at most six plain parameters is admitted. Checksum agreement with a particular xterm checksumExtension or a DEC terminal is not claimed. Direct panes only; persistent sessions stay silent.

Insert Pn (omitted/zero = 1) blank columns at the cursor column on every row of the top/bottom scrolling region, only while the cursor row is inside it; columns pushed past the right edge are lost. Only the exact unprefixed one-parameter identity is admitted. With DECLRMM/DECSLRM margins it acts only while the cursor column is between them and moves only the columns between them (blanks enter at the right margin); without them the margins are the page edges. Cursor, pen, pending wrap, scrollback and the image plane are untouched; introduced blanks carry the live colors and no visual attribute; shifted cells keep attributes, colors, extended text, hyperlinks, underline decoration and DECSCA protection; a wide glyph the shift would split is retired whole.

Delete Pn (omitted/zero = 1) columns at the cursor column on every row of the top/bottom scrolling region, only while the cursor row is inside it; blank columns enter at the right edge. Only the exact unprefixed one-parameter identity is admitted. With DECLRMM/DECSLRM margins it acts only while the cursor column is between them and moves only the columns between them (blanks enter at the right margin); without them the margins are the page edges. Cursor, pen, pending wrap, scrollback and the image plane are untouched; introduced blanks carry the live colors and no visual attribute; shifted cells keep attributes, colors, extended text, hyperlinks, underline decoration and DECSCA protection; a wide glyph the shift would split is retired whole.

Shift every row of the top/bottom scrolling region left by Pn (omitted/zero = 1) columns from the left margin, whatever the cursor column, only while the cursor row is inside the region; blank columns enter at the right edge. Only the exact unprefixed one-parameter CSI Pn SP @ identity is admitted. With DECLRMM/DECSLRM margins it acts only while the cursor column is between them and moves only the columns between them (blanks enter at the right margin); without them the margins are the page edges. Cursor, pen, pending wrap, scrollback and the image plane are untouched; introduced blanks carry the live colors and no visual attribute; shifted cells keep attributes, colors, extended text, hyperlinks, underline decoration and DECSCA protection; a wide glyph the shift would split is retired whole.

Shift every row of the top/bottom scrolling region right by Pn (omitted/zero = 1) columns from the left margin, whatever the cursor column, only while the cursor row is inside the region; columns pushed past the right edge are lost. Only the exact unprefixed one-parameter CSI Pn SP A identity is admitted. With DECLRMM/DECSLRM margins it acts only while the cursor column is between them and moves only the columns between them (blanks enter at the right margin); without them the margins are the page edges. Cursor, pen, pending wrap, scrollback and the image plane are untouched; introduced blanks carry the live colors and no visual attribute; shifted cells keep attributes, colors, extended text, hyperlinks, underline decoration and DECSCA protection; a wide glyph the shift would split is retired whole.
